scope: One bounded read-only review of the principal inference from existing outputs and scoring source. No new model, replay, external research, test, instrumentation, training, decoding change or Git operation. This receipt authorizes none.
recommendation: Prioritize one separately authorized same-checkpoint emission/selection causal-localization work card over another exposure-only dose, retaining both arms, full256 access, weights, fixed prose/source criteria and the observed numerical failures. This prioritizes an observable interface; it does not identify the root cause.
rationale: The completed continuation improved comparison-tail likelihood while failing the fixed prose-improvement decision. These existing outcomes provide no decisive new evidence for another exposure-only dose; they do not prove that additional exposure could never help.

Actual continuous decision traces retain selected and same-prefix greedy token IDs, selected raw model mass, aggregate copy mass, and top source occurrence. The witnessed low-mass choices make the emission/selection interface a specific, inspectable diagnostic starting point.

Keeping the same checkpoint avoids confounding a future localization observation with another optimization trajectory. Both learned distribution/representation and selection behavior remain possible contributors.

The proposed card is a bounded decision about causes, not an automatic sampler replacement or a geometric-admission experiment. Existing numerical and source losses remain independently actionable evidence and cannot be waived by any sampling explanation.
